text: I just sent a wire to that Hootier girl of mine. I said, dear, prepare. I will soon be there. You can tell the rules, and I am coming there to stay. I have dropped the wedding ring, and now I'm on my way to win my Anna in Indiana. She's just as playful as my baby grand piano. Not very nifty. Ways just too nifty.
